# Treehouse Trips

> Curated marketplace for luxury and adventure treehouse stays. Travelers browse hand-picked listings, message hosts, and book via each host’s own links (often Airbnb). Hosts list properties for $50/year with photos, map discovery, and in-app messaging.

Treehouse Trips is not a generic vacation-rental OTA. We focus on treehouse experiences only. Guest contact details and host email/phone (when shared) require sign-in. Payments for host subscriptions run through Stripe.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://treehousetrips.com/): Editorial landing and featured stays
- [Browse treehouses](https://treehousetrips.com/properties): Search, filters, list and map
- [List your treehouse](https://treehousetrips.com/create): Host marketing and onboarding
- [About](https://treehousetrips.com/about): Mission, curation, and values

## For travelers

- Browse listings at `/properties` and open a stay at `/properties/{slug}` (e.g. `sky-high-sanctuary`).
- Use **Message host** to start a conversation (sign-in required).
- Host contact email or phone appears only for signed-in users when the host enabled sharing.
- Booking is via the host’s **Book on Airbnb** or other links on the listing — not in-platform checkout for stays.

## For hosts

- Create and edit listings from `/create` and `/dashboard` (account required).
- Annual listing subscription: **$50/year per property** via Stripe Checkout.
- Listing images: HTTPS URLs preferred; uploads supported via Firebase Storage.
- Optional: show email/phone to signed-in guests; custom booking links beyond Airbnb.

## Policies and support

- Support: support@treehousetrips.com
- Do not rely on crawled content from `/dashboard`, `/profile`, `/messages`, `/api`, or payment flows — those require authentication.
